##: Scoop manifest for concealer. Installs the published PyPI wheel (pip pulls pywinpty/windows-curses). Not yet exercised on a real Scoop host, but url/hash are the live PyPI artifacts. See docs/WINDOWS.md.
description: Local-only secret manager: a typed, scoped, audited wrapper over SOPS + age with a web UI and MCP server.
##depends: python provides pip; sops+age are the binaries concealer wraps. All three live in the Scoop 'main' bucket.
##bin: concealer.cmd sets PYTHONPATH to the vendored lib and runs `python -m concealer`. pip pulls pywinpty/windows-curses as wheel deps into lib.
##autoupdate: pythonhosted URLs are content-addressed (not version-templatable), so autoupdate is manual: bump version + url + hash from the new PyPI release.
